items.name: Deere & Company
items.headline: Q4 net income $1.051B; FY27 net income outlook $4.50-$5.25B
items.thesis: Net sales and revenues were $12,115 million versus $12,394 million, and net income was $1,051 million, or $3.89 per diluted share. Deere forecast FY27 net income of $4.50 to $5.25 billion, including a pension settlement charge.

items.name: HP Inc.
items.headline: Q4 revenue $16.0B; non-GAAP EPS $0.83 includes tariff refund
items.thesis: Revenue was $16,004 million versus $14,639 million. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.83 versus $0.93, and both GAAP and non-GAAP results include a $0.15 favorable tariff refund impact.

items.name: Medtronic
items.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue $9.36B; GAAP EPS includes $2.0B MiniMed separation gain
items.thesis: Revenue was $9,364 million versus $8,961 million, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.20 against non-GAAP of $1.34. The GAAP figure includes a $2.0 billion gain on the MiniMed separation, and fiscal 2027 guidance was maintained.

items.name: Amgen
items.headline: Settles with BMS; Opdivo biosimilar ABP 206 U.S. launch set for Oct. 1, 2028
items.thesis: Amgen reached a settlement with Bristol-Myers Squibb and Ono to resolve U.S. patent litigation over ABP 206, its investigational biosimilar to Opdivo. Launch is planned for October 1, 2028, subject to FDA approval, which the agency is expected to act on by the end of 2026.

items.name: Analog Devices
items.headline: Q4 FY26 revenue $4.37B; Q1 guide $4.4B revenue, adjusted EPS $3.82
items.catalyst: Nov. 24 fiscal Q4 results and outlook.
items.thesis: Revenue was $4,373 million versus $3,076 million and adjusted diluted EPS was $4.06 versus $2.26. ADI guided first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue to $4.4 billion, plus or minus $150 million, with adjusted EPS of $3.82, plus or minus $0.20.

items.name: Best Buy
items.headline: Q3 revenue $10.24B; raises fiscal 2027 outlook
items.thesis: Revenue was $10,236 million versus $9,672 million, with adjusted diluted EPS of $1.62 versus $1.40. The company raised its fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.name: Dollar Tree
items.headline: Q3 revenue $5.08B; fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook raised to $8.05-$8.25
items.thesis: Total revenue was $5,078.4 million versus $4,751.0 million, and adjusted diluted EPS was $1.16 versus $1.21. Dollar Tree raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $8.05 to $8.25.
